title: Screenshot replay video
responsibility: Creates or reuses a cached silent MP4 of the report’s available replay screenshots.

inputs.name: replayVideoKey.report
inputs.description: Report whose ordered replay frame identifiers and filenames determine the cache key.

inputs.name: replayVideo.report
inputs.description: Report providing screenshots and registered evidence files.

inputs.name: replayVideo.directory
inputs.description: Report directory containing assets and the replay cache.

outputs.name: replayVideoKey
outputs.description: SHA-256 key of ordered frame identifiers/filenames and the fixed three-second, 1280-by-720 versioned encoding recipe.

outputs.name: replayVideo
outputs.description: Promise resolving to an existing regular cached MP4 or a newly encoded file. Frames are rendered in batches of four, fitted/padded to 1280 by 720, then encoded at ten frames per second with three seconds per screenshot. Temporary encoding files are removed in finally.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects zero or over 500 frames, symlinked replay cache/artifact, screenshot conversion failure and encoding failure. Asset validation, subprocess and filesystem failures may also propagate.
